limitations: No other independent review or new docs/agent-reports review document consulted.
Files inventoried or hashed are not necessarily individually inspected; scope of image/log inspection is stated in the report.
Baseline visuals and later failed/incomplete runs remain distinct; simulator/fixture evidence is not live tunnel/device approval.
Only local private deliverables; no GitHub publication, implementation changes or CI dispatches.

rubric.vetoes: Existing serious usability / protection-state misrepresentation veto; no physical motion/performance test means no product acceptance.
